lines.explanation: The agent correctly identified both engineering-channel members whose messages received an 👀 reaction — Łukasz Kowalski (U_LUKAS) and Robert Walsh (U03ROBERT23) — matching the card's referent set exactly (no extras, none missing), verified against the eyes reactions on messages 1699824000.000987 and 1706110000.000100 and membership via conversations.members (paragraph 1 frames the search, paragraph 2 lists the two matches). This first requested part is performed. The second requested part — reporting each member's channel join time — was not delivered: the agent explicitly stated it could not determine join timestamps via the available Slack API surface (conversations.history/reactions.get/conversations.members/search.messages), none of which expose a per-channel join_at field in the supplied API docs, and it declared this limitation rather than fabricating a date. This is a genuine, acknowledged execution gap rather than a false factual claim, so the outcome is partially_performed (identification done, join-time reporting omitted/unavailable) rather than execution_failed.
